title: Trimming the Pot Where a Second Counter Stands at the Site
content:
Where an Employee Meal Account's allowance reaches past the cafe and the employer also runs an Unattended Micro Market Program store at the site, the pot a ticket may draw on is trimmed, because a day's allowance is read across both counters together. The kiosk share is 30 percent.

**Clause.** Where the plan's allowance reaches beyond the cafe and the employer's micro market at the account's site stands active, the pot is trimmed by the grant ceiling printed against the plan taken at the kiosk share, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where the plan's allowance reaches beyond the cafe and that micro market is still installing, the pot is trimmed by half of that same figure, likewise rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where neither holds, nothing is trimmed.

## Where each plan's allowance reaches

| Meal plan | Where allowance may be spent |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | the cafe counter only |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | the cafe counter only |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | the cafe counter only |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | the cafe counter and the micro market |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | the cafe counter and the micro market |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | every outlet at the site |

A plan whose allowance may be spent at the cafe counter only does not reach beyond the cafe; the other two reaches both do.

## The bands

| The plan's allowance reach | The micro market agreement at the account's site | Trimmed from the pot |
|---|---|---|
| Beyond the cafe | Active | 30 percent of the grant ceiling printed against the plan |
| Beyond the cafe | Still installing | Half of that figure, that is 15 percent of the printed grant ceiling |
| Beyond the cafe | Suspended, closed, or none at the site | Nothing |
| The cafe counter only | Any | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan whose allowance reaches the cafe counter and the micro market and whose printed grant ceiling for one grant period is $9.00, an active micro market at the site trims $2.70 from the pot, and one still installing trims $1.35.
